# gpupaas_kubernetes_cluster_audit_events (Data Source)

The audit trail of a managed Kubernetes cluster, newest first: who asked for what (create, upgrade, pool changes, node actions) and how it ended. Use it to find out why a cluster changed, or who changed it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Who did what to the cluster, newest first.
data "gpupaas_kubernetes_cluster_audit_events" "upgrades" {
  project = "system-catalog"
  cluster = "my-cluster"
  action  = "cluster.upgrade"
  limit   = 20
}

output "upgrades" {
  value = [for e in data.gpupaas_kubernetes_cluster_audit_events.upgrades.events : "${e.timestamp} ${e.actor} ${e.result}"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster` (String) Name of the cluster.
- `project` (String)

### Optional

- `action` (String) Only events of this action, for example `cluster.upgrade`, `cluster.nodepool.create`, `cluster.metadata.update` or `node.drain`.
- `actor` (String) Only events of this user.
- `from` (String) Only events at or after this time (RFC 3339).
- `limit` (Number) Most events to return. Defaults to 100; the platform caps it at 500.
- `resource_type` (String) Only events about this kind of resource: `cluster`, `controlPlane`, `nodePool`, `node` or `sku`.
- `result` (String) Only events with this result: `accepted`, `rejected`, `completed` or `failed`.
- `to` (String) Only events at or before this time (RFC 3339).

### Read-Only

- `events` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--events))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `total` (Number) How many events match the filters, which can be more than `limit`.

<a id="nestedatt--events"></a>
### Nested Schema for `events`

Read-Only:

- `action` (String)
- `actor` (String)
- `id` (String)
- `message` (String)
- `operation_id` (String) The day-2 operation the event belongs to, if any.
- `resource_name` (String)
- `resource_type` (String)
- `result` (String)
- `timestamp` (String) When the event happened (RFC 3339, UTC).
